passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my new notebook, and the cover is green.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 새 공책이고, 표지는 초록색이에요.

phrases.en: I write an English word, and I draw a small picture.
phrases.ko: 나는 영어 단어를 쓰고, 작은 그림을 그려요.

phrases.en: I bring it to school every day.
The new cover is easy to find in my bag.
phrases.ko: 새 표지는 가방 안에서 찾기 쉬워요.

phrases.en: Each English word has a picture beside it.
Neat writing helps me read my notes.
phrases.ko: 깔끔한 글씨는 내가 노트를 읽도록 도와줘요.

phrases.en: I write at school and also at home.
A green notebook is my favorite one.
phrases.ko: 초록색 공책은 내가 가장 좋아하는 공책이에요.

phrases.en: I take care of it because it is new.
